prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: replacement 16:9 concept illustration for the 'Wind-tunnel motion capture' card of a premium English research project website. Input image 1 is the existing robotic-bird wind-tunnel concept; use it only as the reference for engineering visual quality, camera equipment, subdued graphite/sage/ivory colors and for the scale comparison. Redesign this illustration to show a REAL, naturally feathered falcon taking off and landing inside a much larger low-speed wind-tunnel flight chamber. Make the internal tunnel diameter visually about TWICE that of the reference relative to the same bird scale: a spacious circular-cross-section test chamber with broad transparent/cutaway sidewall, ample clearance above and below fully spread wings, never a cramped box. Show a coherent side-oblique wide view of ONE large tunnel. Within it show exactly TWO separated time-sequence poses of the SAME natural falcon: on the left just lifting off from a low padded perch, wings working and feet leaving the perch; on the right braking to land on another low padded perch, wings raised, tail fanned and feet reaching the perch. Both face right into subtle right-to-left airflow. These are two stages of one illustrative movement sequence, not two animals interacting. Feather patterns, hooked beak, wing and leg anatomy must be realistic; exactly two wings and two legs per pose, no mechanical components or support rod attached to the animal. External high-speed cameras at complementary viewing angles and discreet LED illumination convey motion capture without obscuring birds. Large rounded chamber outline and continuous transparent wall must read clearly; flow-straightener distant and unobtrusive, no exposed fan. Compose tightly enough to remain readable as a small landscape card: entire tunnel test volume, perches and two complete falcon poses visible, cameras near outer edges, no large unused margins. Style: refined realistic scientific cutaway/concept visualization, natural feathers and credible machined materials, soft laboratory light, restrained polished editorial appearance. This is a visualization of PLANNED research, not a documentary photograph or evidence of a completed experiment. No text whatsoever, no letters, labels, numbers, legends, dimensions, logos, watermarks, UI, decorative charts or holograms. Output a clean opaque 16:9 landscape image.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided concept illustration with ONE targeted correction: the tunnel still looks too cramped. Make the apparent internal wind-tunnel diameter about TWICE as large relative to the falcons. Keep the overall 16:9 composition, equipment style, natural falcon identities, exactly two temporal poses (left take-off, right landing), lighting and no-text presentation. Achieve the corrected scale by reducing BOTH falcon figures and their padded perch crossbars to about 50 percent of their current linear size within the existing broad chamber framing. The chamber internal clear height should be approximately 3.5 to 4 times the full vertical spread of each falcon's wings, instead of under 2 times. Keep birds and perch crossbars close to the horizontal centreline of the test volume using slender taller perch posts, leaving clearly visible generous headroom AND floor clearance. Keep the two birds distinctly readable and separated left/right, with exactly two anatomically natural feathered wings and two legs each. Left is visibly just taking off from its perch; right is braking with feet extended toward its perch. Preserve wide transparent rounded/circular test section, outside machine-vision cameras and soft LED lights, no exposed fan. Keep the complete chamber visible; no cropping or extra closeup insets, no additional birds or objects, no typography, no labels, no numbers, no dimensions, no watermark. Retain a realistic polished technical concept illustration, not experimental evidence.
